entities.name: Planeswalker
entities.description: Powerful, mortal spellcasters with the innate ability to traverse the planes of the Multiverse.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: The collection of planes that planeswalkers travel between.

entities.name: Spark
entities.description: The ability that makes a person a planeswalker; it can ignite or be lost.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A team of heroic planeswalkers allied against interplanar threats.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: The event after which planeswalkers were no longer godlike in power.

entities.name: Compleation
entities.description: The Phyrexian process some planeswalkers underwent in the Phyrexian storyline arc.

entities.name: March of the Machine
entities.description: The storyline after which most planeswalkers lost their sparks.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths used by recurring non-planeswalker characters to travel between planes.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker, one of the first five planeswalker cards, archetypal of white until replaced by Gideon.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker, one of the first five planeswalker cards.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker, one of the first five planeswalker cards.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker, one of the first five planeswalker cards, and the most prominent with 23 unique cards.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker, one of the first five planeswalker cards.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and Gatewatch member who replaced Ajani as the archetypal white planeswalker.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker and Gatewatch member who replaced Garruk as the archetypal green planeswalker.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker used as an example of a planeswalker type.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A character who was chosen not to be made an artifact planeswalker.

events.summary: The Phyrexian storyline arc sees a number of planeswalker characters experience compleation.
events.quote: the Phyrexian storyline arc saw a number of Planeswalker characters experience compleation

events.summary: After March of the Machine most of the Multiverse's planeswalkers lose their sparks and are desparked.
events.quote: most of the Multiverse's Planeswalkers have been desparked and are now depicted on legendary creature cards

events.summary: Gideon Jura and Nissa Revane replace Ajani and Garruk as the archetypal white and green planeswalkers as the Gatewatch story begins.
events.quote: Gideon Jura and Nissa Revane replaced Ajani and Garruk as the archetypal white and green Planeswalkers, respectively.

relations.note: Gideon is among the first five Gatewatch members whose backstories Origins depicted.
relations.quote: Origins depicted the backstories of the first five Gatewatch members
